not_used.confidence: it gives each grain a probability, not a detector confidence; see 'Minimum grain probability' under More settings.
not_used.dedup: it merges the grains found in its overlapping tiles itself.

settings.label: Remove grains cut by the image edge
settings.help: Drops grains touching the image edge. On quadrat photos PebbleMapper removes the frame band anyway.
settings.differs_because: PebbleMapper excludes the quadrat frame band after detection, so the grains inside the frame that touch the photograph's edge are kept rather than lost.

settings.label: Overlap of Segmenteverygrain's own tiles
settings.help: How much Segmenteverygrain's tiles overlap. Higher: fewer grains cut at tile seams, slower.

ortho.derived: the Detect tab's Overlap × the tile size in pixels (0.3 × tile when the Overlap is 0), at least 64 px

settings.differs_because: chosen in PebbleMapper's first Segmenteverygrain release so that grains up to about 600 pixels across lie whole in at least one tile; it was not measured against the authors' value.

settings.label: Minimum grain area
settings.help: Smaller grains are dropped. Higher: fewer specks, fewer small grains.

authors.source: segmenteverygrain predict_large_image: no minimum by default

settings.differs_because: drops specks of a few pixels, which cannot be measured reliably.

settings.label: Size of Segmenteverygrain's own tiles
settings.help: The side of Segmenteverygrain's tiles. Higher: more context per tile, more graphics memory.

ortho.derived: the Detect tab's Tile size in pixels, between 512 and 4096

settings.differs_because: for orthos PebbleMapper follows the Tile size chosen on the Detect tab.

settings.label: Refine outlines with Segment Anything
settings.help: Outlines grains with Segment Anything: sharper, slower. Off: the U-Net's own outlines.

settings.label: Dilation of the U-Net outlines
settings.help: Grows each U-Net outline by this much. Higher: larger outlines.
settings.differs_because: kept from PebbleMapper's first Segmenteverygrain release; it changes nothing while SAM is on, which is the default.

settings.label: Grouping distance of the U-Net prompts
settings.help: U-Net points closer than this make one grain. Higher: neighbours merge more; lower: grains split more.

settings.label: Smallest grain prompted
settings.help: Smaller U-Net regions are not looked at. Higher: small grains are missed.

settings.label: Minimum grain probability
settings.help: Drops grains the U-Net is less sure of. Higher: fewer, surer grains; 0: none dropped.

authors.source: not part of segmenteverygrain: a PebbleMapper filter

fixed.label: Segment Anything checkpoint
fixed.reason: the checkpoint this release downloads and checks.

fixed.label: U-Net model
fixed.reason: the model trained by the authors and pinned by this release.
